calls.head: Top line on top line: Zegras vs. Fantilli
calls.body: At home, the Flyers keep sending Zegras’s line (Zegras, Dvorak and Acciari) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Rick Tocchet has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Blue Jackets’ first line is Nichushkin, Fantilli and Johnson.

calls.head: The Blue Jackets’ edge in shots from defensemen
calls.body: The Blue Jackets are one of the league’s best for shots from defensemen, and the Flyers are near the bottom. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.
calls.call: The Blue Jackets’ defensemen take a bigger share of the team’s shot attempts than the Flyers’.

surprises.head: Columbus won against the run of play
surprises.body: With chances like these, Philadelphia would win about 71 games in 100. Columbus won anyway.

surprises.head: Philadelphia found the good looks for once
surprises.body: Philadelphia usually gets some of the league’s least dangerous shots. Not tonight: an 8.5% chance of scoring on the average shot at 5-on-5, against their usual 6.0% and a league average of 6.3%. A team strays this far about once every 25 games.

story.head: The Blue Jackets steal one in Philadelphia
paras: Adam Fantilli, Kent Johnson and Denton Mateychuk scored three goals in less than three minutes midway through the first to put the Blue Jackets up 3-0. Noah Cates got the Flyers on the board midway through the second. Trevor Zegras and Jamie Drysdale scored less than five minutes apart with just under five minutes left to tie it 3-3. Johnson won it with his second goal of the night less than three minutes into overtime. He added an assist for a three-point night.

The Blue Jackets got away with one. The Flyers had the better of the chances. Replay those chances a hundred times and the Flyers win about seven in ten. Cam Talbot made 28 saves for the Blue Jackets, and Dan Vladař stopped 11 of 15 at the other end. The Jackets improved to 5-5-0 and took seventh place in the Metropolitan from the Flyers, who dropped to 3-7-4 and sank to the bottom of the division.

items.text: It was the Blue Jackets’ first road win of the season, in their third road game.
Trevor Zegras has a point in five straight games.
Adam Fantilli extended his point streak against Philadelphia to six games.
The Blue Jackets have beaten the Flyers six straight times, going back to the 2024-25 season.
